events.title: Panel: HCI/HCDE Role Possibilities
events.description:
Join us in JHN 175 (Johnson Hall)
This panel will provide insight into all the different options and opportunities available to an HCDE/HCI+D or any UX graduate. Panelists will share their journeys, what their roles look like, and answer host questions. This will be followed by an audience Q&A and networking opportunities.

Speakers:
Emily Rapada - Senior Staff Researcher, Pinterest
Swati Sachdeva - SWE + Researcher, Google
Julianne Bryant - UX Senior Manager, Google
Sola Chang - Senior UX/UI Game Designer, Blizzard

This event will be in person only and will not be recorded. Please RSVP yes if you intend on coming in person, and if your plans change, please update your RSVP so our friends on the waitlist can join us :)
